title: Decide the watcher, the silence limit and the single-base case
goal: A short design note says which base watches, after how many minutes of missed heartbeats it speaks, on which channel, and what a single-base install gets
acceptance: docs/design/ names the watcher (a standby base over the Kaji line; the phone PWA only if it can run in the background) with the code it reuses (src/kaji-link.ts heartbeat tracking)
The silence limit N and the recovery rule are proposed with their reasons (sleep, update restarts and Kaji reconnects must not page the owner)
The single-base case is stated: what is covered, what is not
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: read the Kaji heartbeat and one-channel code, write one page. Not a measurement.
